inputs.label: Aspect ratio for the generated video. Set to '9:16' for portrait/vertical videos (TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, YouTube Shorts, mobile-first viewing). Set to '16:9' for landscape/horizontal (default, YouTube, cinematic). Veo does NOT support square (1:1). If the user mentions a vertical format, mobile-first, social shorts, or any portrait orientation, set this to '9:16'.

inputs.name: person_generation
inputs.label: Whether the generated video may include people. Set to 'allow_all' for any people (children + adults — Veo 2 only, downgraded to 'allow_adult' on Veo 3.1 in EU/UK/CH/MENA). Set to 'allow_adult' to allow adults only (the safest universal choice; works on every model and region). Set to 'dont_allow' to exclude people entirely (use for scenery, products, abstract motion). If the user mentions people, characters, faces, or human subjects in the prompt and doesn't object to people, set this to 'allow_adult'.

options.name: Allow adults (default — works on every model and region)
Allow all (Veo 2 only outside EU/UK; downgrades on Veo 3.1 in EU/UK)

category.name: CRM
category.description: Customer relationship management — contacts, companies, deals, and tickets

sub_category.name: Salesforce
sub_category.description: Manage Salesforce leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, cases, tasks, and any custom object

inputs.name: access_token
inputs.label: Salesforce Connection
inputs.placeholder: Connect Salesforce, or paste an access token

inputs.name: instance_url
inputs.label: Salesforce Instance URL
inputs.placeholder: Leave blank — taken from your connection

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Product Name
inputs.placeholder: GenWatt Diesel 200kW - what the product is called on quotes and deals

inputs.name: product_code
inputs.label: Product Code
inputs.placeholder: GC1040 - your own catalogue code for this product

inputs.name: description
inputs.label: Description
inputs.placeholder: What the product is, in the words a customer would recognise

inputs.name: is_active
inputs.label: Ready To Sell (leave off and it is still switched on)

inputs.name: family
inputs.label: Product Family
inputs.placeholder: Must match a value in your org's Product Family list - Salesforce accepts anything else without complaining and stores it as typed

inputs.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
inputs.label: Sold In Units Of
inputs.placeholder: Each - must match your org's Quantity Unit Of Measure list

inputs.name: stock_keeping_unit
inputs.label: Stock Code (SKU)
inputs.placeholder: SKU-000142 - the code your warehouse or shop uses

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.label: Your Reference
inputs.placeholder: ERP-000142 - a plain text box on the product; Salesforce does NOT treat it as an External ID, so Create or Update Product cannot match on it

inputs.name: product_type
inputs.label: Bundle Type
inputs.placeholder: Leave blank for an ordinary product

options.name: Bundle (sold as a package of products)

inputs.name: additional_fields
inputs.label: Additional Fields
inputs.placeholder: {"My_Custom_Field__c":"value"} - any other field on the product

devops/azuredevops/workitem_query_wiql.author: Dave McElin
devops/azuredevops/workitem_query_wiql.name: Azure DevOps: Query Work Items (WIQL)
devops/azuredevops/workitem_query_wiql.description: Run a WIQL query and return the matching work items, fully populated. WIQL itself returns ONLY id references no matter what the SELECT clause lists, so this action hydrates them for you (in batches of 200) — otherwise the results would be unusable in a flow. Cap your query with a WHERE clause: large result sets are expensive and are trimmed at 2000 items.

inputs.name: awx_password
inputs.label: Password

inputs.name: allow_insecure
inputs.label: Allow Insecure TLS
inputs.placeholder: Skip certificate verification — only for a self-hosted AWX with a self-signed certificate

inputs.name: api_prefix
inputs.label: API Path Prefix (advanced)
inputs.placeholder: Leave blank — detected automatically. Only set this if support asks (e.g. /api/controller/v2/).

inputs.name: adhoc_command_id
inputs.label: Ad-Hoc Command ID
inputs.placeholder: The ID of the ad-hoc command, e.g. 42 — Run Ad-Hoc Command returns it

infrastructure/awx/adhoc_command_run.name: AWX: Run Ad-Hoc Command
infrastructure/awx/adhoc_command_run.description: Run a single Ansible module against the hosts in an inventory — ping them, restart a service, or run a shell command. This executes immediately on the target hosts.

category.name: Infrastructure
category.description: Provision and manage infrastructure as code

sub_category.name: AAP / AWX
sub_category.description: Ansible Automation Platform / AWX — launch existing job templates and workflows, watch jobs to completion, and manage inventories, hosts, projects, credentials and schedules. This node talks to the AWX/AAP controller's API; it does not run playbooks itself.

inputs.name: awx_url
inputs.label: AWX / AAP URL
inputs.placeholder: https://awx.example.com — your AWX or Ansible Automation Platform address

inputs.name: api_token
inputs.label: API Token
inputs.placeholder: AWX ▸ your user ▸ Tokens ▸ Add, Application blank, Scope = Write. Shown once — copy it then.

inputs.name: awx_password
inputs.label: Password
inputs.placeholder: your AWX password — note some AWX installs disable password authentication

inputs.name: allow_insecure
inputs.label: Allow Insecure TLS
inputs.placeholder: Skip certificate verification — only for a self-hosted AWX with a self-signed certificate

inputs.name: api_prefix
inputs.label: API Path Prefix (advanced)
inputs.placeholder: Leave blank — detected automatically. Only set this if support asks (e.g. /api/controller/v2/).

inputs.name: inventory_id
inputs.label: Inventory
inputs.placeholder: The inventory whose hosts the module runs against

inputs.name: credential_id
inputs.label: Machine Credential
inputs.placeholder: The SSH / machine credential AWX logs into the hosts with — an ad-hoc command cannot run without one

inputs.name: module_name
inputs.label: Module
inputs.placeholder: command (the default) · shell · ping · service · yum · apt · setup · win_ping … — short names only, never ansible.builtin.shell

inputs.name: module_args
inputs.label: Module Arguments
inputs.placeholder: systemctl restart nginx — required for the command and shell modules

inputs.name: limit
inputs.label: Limit
inputs.placeholder: web*:&prod — blank targets EVERY host in the inventory

inputs.name: forks
inputs.label: Forks
inputs.placeholder: How many hosts to work on at once — blank uses the AWX default

inputs.name: become_enabled
inputs.label: Run with sudo (become)
inputs.placeholder: Escalate to root on the target hosts

inputs.name: diff_mode
inputs.label: Show Changes (diff mode)
inputs.placeholder: Report what each host would change, line by line

inputs.name: extra_vars
inputs.label: Extra Variables
inputs.placeholder: {"target_dir":"/srv"} — AWX rejects any variable whose name starts with ansible_

inputs.name: execution_environment_id
inputs.label: Execution Environment
inputs.placeholder: Blank uses the inventory's / AWX's default execution environment

inputs.name: wait_for_completion
inputs.label: Wait for Completion
inputs.placeholder: Hold the flow until the command finishes, then return its status and output

inputs.name: poll_interval_seconds
inputs.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
inputs.placeholder: How often to check the command — default 5s

inputs.name: timeout_seconds
inputs.label: Timeout (seconds)
inputs.placeholder: Give up waiting after this long — default 600s (max 3600). The command is NOT cancelled.

inputs.name: ignore_job_failure
inputs.label: Ignore Command Failure
inputs.placeholder: By default the node fails when the AWX command ends failed/error/canceled. Tick to succeed regardless.

inputs.name: include_stdout
inputs.label: Include Output
inputs.placeholder: Return the command's plain-text output (up to 1 MB)

inputs.name: confirm_destructive
inputs.label: Confirm Destructive Action
inputs.placeholder: This runs a command on real hosts. Tick to allow, or bind a variable such as ${var.approved}

messagebrokers/azureservicebus/deadlette.author: Dave McElin
messagebrokers/azureservicebus/deadlette.name: Azure Service Bus: Receive Dead-Lettered
messagebrokers/azureservicebus/deadlette.description: Receive from the dead-letter queue of a queue or subscription, exposing the dead-letter reason and description that say why each message ended up there. Messages arrive here automatically once delivery attempts exceed MaxDeliveryCount (default 10), or on expiry. A dead-letter queue has no dead-letter queue of its own, so abandoning here simply redelivers. Settlement happens HERE, in this node, because a lock token belongs to the AMQP connection that took it — a downstream Complete node is impossible, and when this node's link closes the broker releases anything unsettled immediately. Defer is the one handoff that survives: its sequence numbers are durable, so another flow can pick the message up with Receive Deferred Messages.

messagebrokers/azureservicebus/message_d.author: Dave McElin
messagebrokers/azureservicebus/message_d.name: Azure Service Bus: Dead-Letter Messages
messagebrokers/azureservicebus/message_d.description: Receive messages and dead-letter all of them with a reason and description — the receive-inspect-reject shape, in one step. This is the only dead-letter action that is not a disposition on a receive, and it still receives first for the same reason: a lock token cannot cross nodes, so there is nothing a standalone reject node could hold on to. To dead-letter conditionally, use Receive from Queue with Then = Dead-Letter behind a filter.

messagebrokers/azureservicebus/queue_rec.author: Dave McElin
messagebrokers/azureservicebus/queue_rec.name: Azure Service Bus: Receive from Queue
messagebrokers/azureservicebus/queue_rec.description: Receive messages from a queue and settle them in the same step: complete, abandon, dead-letter or defer. Settlement happens HERE, in this node, because a lock token belongs to the AMQP connection that took it — a downstream Complete node is impossible, and when this node's link closes the broker releases anything unsettled immediately. Defer is the one handoff that survives: its sequence numbers are durable, so another flow can pick the message up with Receive Deferred Messages.

messagebrokers/azureservicebus/subscript.author: Dave McElin
messagebrokers/azureservicebus/subscript.name: Azure Service Bus: Receive from Subscription
messagebrokers/azureservicebus/subscript.description: Receive messages from a topic subscription and settle them in the same step. Messages live on the subscription, not the topic — a topic cannot be received from. Settlement happens HERE, in this node, because a lock token belongs to the AMQP connection that took it — a downstream Complete node is impossible, and when this node's link closes the broker releases anything unsettled immediately. Defer is the one handoff that survives: its sequence numbers are durable, so another flow can pick the message up with Receive Deferred Messages.

plan/create.author: Andy Esser

category.name: Plan
category.description: Create and manage autonomous multi-step plans the agent progresses on its own.

inputs.name: title
inputs.label: Short plan title — shown to the user and on the plan-detail view

inputs.placeholder: Pull this quarter's metrics, summarise for leadership, send for sign-off.

inputs.name: plan_id
inputs.label: Plan identifier — the UUID returned by plan/create

outputs.name: tool_result
outputs.label: One-line summary the AI reads first

outputs.name: plan_json
outputs.label: Full {plan, tasks} payload as JSON for AI drill-down

plan/revise.author: Andy Esser
plan/revise.name: Plan / Revise
plan/revise.description: Modify a plan's task graph: add, remove, or update tasks. Allowed on draft, blocked, and active plans.

category.name: Plan
category.description: Create and manage autonomous multi-step plans the agent progresses on its own.

inputs.name: plan_id
inputs.label: Plan identifier — the UUID returned by plan/create

inputs.name: add_tasks
inputs.label: Optional JSON array of new tasks to add. Each must have `name` and `description`; can also include `depends_on`, `inputs`, `flow_id` + `flow_revision_id`

inputs.name: remove_tasks
inputs.label: Optional JSON array of task names to remove. Only pending, failed, and cancelled tasks can be removed

inputs.name: update_tasks
inputs.label: Optional JSON array of partial updates. Each must have `name`; provide only the fields you want to change

plan/start.author: Andy Esser

plan/start.description: Start a draft plan you previously authored. Transitions the plan from draft to active and begins dispatching tasks.

category.name: Plan
category.description: Create and manage autonomous multi-step plans the agent progresses on its own.

inputs.label: Watch

trigger/awx_webhook.author: David McElin
trigger/awx_webhook.name: AWX Job Trigger
trigger/awx_webhook.description: Triggers a flow when an AWX / AAP job starts, succeeds, fails or is canceled. Flomation registers the notification in AWX automatically. Note that AWX sends each notification once and never retries, so an event raised while Flomation is unreachable is lost.

inputs.name: awx_url
inputs.label: AWX / AAP URL
inputs.placeholder: https://awx.example.com — your AWX or Ansible Automation Platform address

inputs.name: api_token
inputs.label: API Token
inputs.placeholder: AWX ▸ your user ▸ Tokens ▸ Add, Application blank, Scope = Write. Shown once — copy it then.

inputs.name: awx_password
inputs.label: Password
inputs.placeholder: your AWX password — note some AWX installs disable password authentication

inputs.name: allow_insecure
inputs.label: Allow Insecure TLS
inputs.placeholder: Skip certificate verification — only for a self-hosted AWX with a self-signed certificate

inputs.name: api_prefix
inputs.label: API Path Prefix (advanced)
inputs.placeholder: Leave blank — detected automatically. Only set this if support asks (e.g. /api/controller/v2/).

inputs.name: template_kind
inputs.label: Template Type
inputs.placeholder: A job template, or a workflow template

inputs.name: job_template_id
inputs.label: Job Template
inputs.placeholder: Pick the job template to watch

inputs.name: workflow_template_id
inputs.label: Workflow Template
inputs.placeholder: Pick the workflow template to watch

inputs.name: skip_awx_verification
inputs.label: Skip AWX Verification
inputs.placeholder: Leave unticked. AWX does not sign its webhooks, so Flomation confirms each one against AWX before firing the flow. Tick only if these credentials cannot read jobs.

trigger/mqtt.author: Dave McElin
trigger/mqtt.name: MQTT Trigger
trigger/mqtt.description: Start a flow whenever a message arrives on an MQTT topic. Flomation holds a subscription open to your broker and runs the flow the moment a message is published. Wildcards are supported: + matches one level, # matches the rest.

inputs.name: host
inputs.label: Broker Host
inputs.placeholder: broker.example.com — hostname or IP, no scheme

inputs.name: username
inputs.label: Username
inputs.placeholder: Leave empty for an anonymous broker

inputs.name: client_id
inputs.label: Client ID
inputs.placeholder: Leave empty unless your broker requires a specific client ID (AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub)

inputs.name: ca_certificate
inputs.label: CA Certificate
inputs.placeholder: PEM-encoded CA cert — only for a privately-signed broker

inputs.name: client_certificate
inputs.label: Client Certificate
inputs.placeholder: PEM-encoded client cert — only for mutual-TLS brokers

inputs.name: client_key
inputs.label: Client Key
inputs.placeholder: PEM-encoded client private key — only for mutual-TLS brokers

inputs.name: allow_insecure
inputs.label: Allow Insecure TLS
inputs.placeholder: Skip certificate verification — only for a self-signed broker

inputs.name: topics
inputs.label: Topics
inputs.placeholder: sensors/# — separate several with commas; add :1 or :2 after a topic to raise its delivery guarantee

inputs.name: default_qos
inputs.label: Delivery Guarantee (QoS)
inputs.placeholder: Applies to every topic that doesn't set its own

inputs.name: parse_json
inputs.label: Parse JSON Payload
inputs.placeholder: Decode the payload into fields you can reference downstream

inputs.name: durable
